nodes.name: NiFe LDH α-to-γ phase transformation
nodes.procedure: Under applied anodic potentials in 0.1 M KOH electrolyte during OER conditions (~1.7 V_RHE), NiFe LDH oxidizes from as-prepared α-phase (interlayer distance 7.8 Å) to activated γ-phase (interlayer distance 7.2 Å) with ~8% lattice contraction and anion-to-cation switching (CO₃²⁻ expulsion, K⁺ intercalation).
nodes.source_text: under applied anodic potentials... MFe LDHs oxidize from as-prepared α-phases to activated γ-phases... characterized by ~8% contraction... switching of the intercalated ions.

nodes.description: Stable CV curves in 0.1 M KOH grazing incident cell
nodes.source_text: The CV curves in Fig. 1b indicate that both NiFe LDH and CoFe LDH undergo redox transitions prior to (or slightly overlapping with) the onset of the OER... For NiFe LDH, the Ni(II) oxidation peak at +1.47 V_RHE (A′) overlaps with the OER onset and with the corresponding reduction wave peaks at +1.35 V_RHE (B′).

nodes.description: Stable CV curves in 0.1 M KOH grazing incident cell
nodes.source_text: For CoFe LDH, the main oxidation peak at +1.35 V_RHE (A) occurs clearly prior to any OER onset. More anodically, a second and small oxidation shoulder at around +1.55 V_RHE (C) overlaps with the OER. The broad peaks B at +1.1 V_RHE and D at +1.4 V_RHE constitute the corresponding reduction waves on the cathodic scan, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH shows reversible α-to-γ phase transformation under operando conditions: interlayer distance contracts from 7.8 Å to 7.2 Å (~8% contraction), in-plane metal-metal distance contracts from ~3.1 Å to ~2.85 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For NiFe LDH, the shoulder at the interlayer distance of 7.2 Å (γ-phase) disappeared at the resting state... and the peak restored to the original value of 7.8 Å (α-phase), which indicates the reversibility of the α-to-γ transformation.

properties.description: Graph showing shift of (003) peak with applied voltage

nodes.characterization_summary: CoFe LDH shows α-to-γ phase transformation under operando conditions with limited reversibility: interlayer distance contracts from 7.7 Å to 7.1 Å (~8% contraction), in-plane metal-metal distance contracts from ~3.1 Å to ~2.85 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the CoFe LDH... the re-expansion to the original value (7.7 Å) is very limited under the resting state (1 V_RHE) and is still incomplete at lower potentials (0.5 V_RHE).

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando XAS provides ensemble-averaged local structural and electronic structure information for NiFe and CoFe LDHs, showing oxidation state changes consistent with incomplete α-to-γ phase transitions observed by WAXS.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This incompleteness makes the quantitative interpretation of XAS data challenging, as the measured local structures and electronic structures are weighted averages of the two phases.
